scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm --prefix ./backend run dev" "npx wait-on -t 90000 http-get://127.0.0.1:3333/api/health && npm --prefix ./vue-app run dev"
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix ./backend install && npx --prefix ./backend prisma generate --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix ./backend prisma migrate deploy --schema=./backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix ./backend run db:seed
scripts.render:build: cd backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run db:seed
